findings.field: Detailed description; contextMenus permission justification; storage permission justification
findings.evidence: Since .479, the candidate adds a signed-in Swipe File surface in src/config/sidepanel-visibility.ts and src/entrypoints/sidepanel/App.tsx, plus a page/link context-menu action in src/lib/context-menus/setup.ts. src/lib/swipe-file/save.ts routes a user-selected URL through ingestPost into an organization collection, and src/lib/swipe-file/receipt.ts plus src/lib/swipe-file/store.ts persist a local receipt and last collection. Current Store description and contextMenus/storage justifications do not name this feature or local receipt/cache behavior.

findings.field: Detailed description; privacy policy disclosure; reviewer instructions
findings.evidence: Candidate adds src/features/data/LiveDataOffer.tsx, visible to signed-in users in DataView. It offers a current-page data-source fetch only after click, quotes estimated points, and calls the paid fetch route; src/lib/api/routes/data-sources.ts requires the active organization header and posts source key, page URL, and maximum records to the service. The contract returns billed records and USD cost. Current Store prose does not describe the account/org requirement, point-metered fetch, or data sent. Review the existing statement 'No paid subscription is required' against the actual points/free allowance before retaining it.

Parent directly verified the live extension privacy policy, updated Oct 15. It explicitly covers Swipe File URL transfer to Matrx/external social-data providers, post/media/transcript, selected organization collection, notes/tags, shared-cache retention after removal, Supabase storage, and signed-in-only access. It also covers configuration diagnostics installation/version/build/setting read counts/times/source status, with no raw values or page browsing list. This satisfies the identified Swipe File collection/transfer disclosure; no privacy-policy edit is indicated by this review. Data-source fetch/points disclosure was not explicitly confirmed in the policy and remains a Store copy/reviewer item.

findings.field: Permissions, hosts, CSP, externally_connectable, web-accessible resources, static content scripts
findings.evidence: The exact candidate manifest matches the approved published 0.2.205 baseline; the Store entrypoint allowlist remains unchanged. No new manifest permission/host/CSP/connectable/resource/content-script reach was identified. No new Store data-use checkbox category was identified from the reviewed source paths.

findings.field: Remote code disclosure and public no-login path
findings.evidence: The exact ZIP passes the current risk detector and contains no rejected PDFObject CDN reference or Gist srcDoc/script loader; the 'No remote code' disclosure remains supported. Existing unauthenticated capture/SEO/limited-chat path remains a truthful public route because the new Swipe File and Live Data surfaces require sign-in. Reviewer instructions should preserve that guest path and add a focused signed-in non-admin route/evidence for Swipe File and Live Data. LiveDataOffer estimates points when available; when it cannot estimate, the UI says 'cost shown after run', so do not promise every fetch quotes a definite cost before running.

The candidate adds @ai-matrx/kit/outbound-react attribution decoration with fixed utm_source=aimatrx.com and utm_medium=referral parameters. Reviewed code and package notes do not establish a new user-specific data category from this behavior.

limitations: This is package/source evidence, not browser acceptance. The separately assigned guest and non-admin exact-ZIP runs were pending during this review; no user-path behavior is certified here.

The canonical Chrome Web Store record still reflects the earlier 0.2.479 rejection and pending candidate state; it needs its authorized current-state update after acceptance and any eventual submission.

The canonical record does not contain the full privacy policy body or current live Store console content; prose verification is therefore limited to the recorded fields and must be confirmed against the actual listing and policy before upload.
